Healthy.symptoms: No prominent disease pattern was identified.
immediate_action: Maintain balanced nutrition and good drainage.
management: Use clean seed and crop rotation.
loss_minimization: Keep a photographic record for comparison.

Soybean rust.symptoms: Small tan to reddish-brown lesions may develop, often beginning in lower leaves.
immediate_action: Inspect surrounding plants and lower canopy leaves.
Record affected rows and monitor spread within 3–5 days.
Seek locally approved fungicide guidance from an agricultural officer.
loss_minimization: Act early and prioritise affected zones for scouting.

Frogeye leaf spot.symptoms: Circular lesions with pale centres and darker reddish-brown margins can appear on leaves.
immediate_action: Inspect nearby plants for similar lesions.
Remove heavily affected plant residue after harvest.
Consult local crop guidance for approved controls.
management: Rotate crops and choose tolerant varieties.
loss_minimization: Document hotspots to plan next-season rotation.

Bacterial blight.symptoms: Irregular water-soaked or brown leaf spots, sometimes with yellow halos.
immediate_action: Avoid handling wet plants to reduce spread.
Improve drainage and avoid overhead irrigation when possible.
Consult a local expert before applying any treatment.
management: Use disease-free seed and field sanitation.
loss_minimization: Separate monitoring of affected patches from healthy areas.

Downy mildew.symptoms: Yellow patches may appear on the upper surface with greyish growth below in humid conditions.
immediate_action: Check lower leaf surfaces in the morning.
loss_minimization: Monitor after humid or rainy periods.

Septoria brown spot.symptoms: Small irregular brown spots commonly begin on lower leaves and may cause yellowing.
immediate_action: Track whether symptoms are moving upward in the canopy.
Reduce crop residue where practical after harvest.
Consult local advice for any chemical decision.
management: Use crop rotation and field sanitation.

immediate_action: Ask a local agricultural extension officer to inspect the crop.
management: Do not apply treatment solely on this result.
